en: I slaughtered the sheep early in the morning.
I didn't slaughter the chicken today.
Did you slaughter your ram?
Why didn't you slaughter the chicken yesterday?
Did you (f.) slaughter the chicken for dinner?
You (f.) didn't slaughter the ram today.
My father slaughtered the sheep on the roof.
He didn't slaughter his ram.
My sister slaughtered the chicken for lunch.
She didn't slaughter the goat today.
We slaughtered the sheep with the family.
We didn't slaughter the ram this year.
Did you (pl.) slaughter your sheep?
You (pl.) didn't slaughter in the morning.

lat: huma deb7u juj djajat l l-3sha
en: They slaughtered two chickens for dinner.
The neighbors haven't slaughtered the ram yet.
I slaughter chickens on the farm.
I don't slaughter the sheep by myself.
You (m.) slaughter with your knife.
You (m.) don't slaughter in the house.
You (f.) slaughter the chicken well.
You (f.) don't slaughter your ram.

lat: l-jezzar kaydbe7 kul nhar f s-suq
en: The butcher slaughters every day at the market.
He doesn't slaughter during Eid.
My mother slaughters chickens every Friday.

lat: hiya ma katdbe7sh l-kebsh b yeddha
en: She doesn't slaughter the ram with her hand.
We slaughter the ram on Eid.
We don't slaughter goats at home.
You (pl.) slaughter chickens for the party.

en: You (pl.) don't slaughter in this place.
They slaughter cows early in the morning.

lat: huma ma kaydeb7ush d-djaj f s-suq
en: They don't slaughter chickens at the market.

lat: ghadi ndbe7 l-kebsh ghedda f s-sba7
en: I am going to slaughter the ram tomorrow morning.
I am not going to slaughter the sheep today.
Are you (m.) going to slaughter the chicken now?

ar: نتا ما غاديش تدبح الكبش ديالك

You (f.) are going to slaughter the chicken for lunch.

ar: نتي ما غاديش تدبحي هاد الدجاجة

lat: huwa ma ghadish ydbe7 had l-3am

lat: khti ghadi tdbe7 d-djaja l l-3sha

lat: hiya ma ghadish tdbe7 d-djaj l-yum

lat: ntuma ma ghadish tdeb7u f s-sta7

ar: هما غادي يدبحو جوج كباش فالعيد
en: They are going to slaughter two rams at Eid.

lat: huma ma ghadish ydeb7u d-djaj l-yum
ar: هما ما غاديش يدبحو الدجاج اليوم
en: They are not going to slaughter chickens today.
